title: Lafourche Parish Sheriff seeks public help to find missing 14-year-old Darell Danos
text:
Lafourche Parish Sheriff Craig Webre is asking for the public’s assistance in locating 14-year-old Darell Danos of New Haven Street in Mathews, who was last seen leaving his home shortly after 10:30 p.m. on May 26.
Danos is described as being 5 feet 7 inches tall and weighing approximately 120 pounds with black hair. According to authorities, he was last seen wearing a short-sleeved navy blue “Legacy” soccer jersey, dark-colored sweatpants, and cheetah-print slide sandals.
The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office urges anyone with information regarding Danos’ whereabouts to call (985) 532-2808 or dial 911.
No additional details about the circumstances of his disappearance have been released at this time.
